The '''Sith familiar''' was a type of [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sith-developed creature]] that resembled a small scavenger [[Bird/Legends|bird]]. Familiars were created by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&mdash;an order of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] adherents&mdash;and were produced via [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. A familiar was [[Force-bond/Legends|bonded]] via [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to the individual who created it, which allowed the master of a familiar to experience the sights and sounds encountered by his or her familiar and to project [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] via the creatures, as if the master was at the familiar's location in person.

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] familiar was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] creature that had the appearance of a small scavenger [[Bird/Legends|bird]]. Familiars were created by the Sith, an order of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]]-wielding adepts. Such creatures were winged and possessed the ability to fly, and typically they had a wingspan of about 1.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. Sith familiars were [[Sithspawn/Legends|brought into existence]] via the application of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] from information recorded on [[Sith scroll/Legends|Sith scrolls]] and within [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]]; the process was expensive and [[Time/Legends|time]]-consuming, requiring some 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] of materials and alchemical apparatus to complete. The creatures were also fragile and easily damaged by combat.<ref name="Gamer 5" />

==Behavior==
Sith familiars were [[Force-bond/Legends|bonded]] to their creators via [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], allowing the master of such a creature to experience the sights and sounds that crossed the path of his or her familiar. In addition, the master of a familiar could use the beast as a conduit through which select [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] could be projected, as if the master was at the familiar's location. Abilities that could be channeled via a Sith familiar included the powers [[Drain Knowledge]], [[Tutaminis|Force defense]], [[Force empathy/Legends|Force empathy]], [[Force stealth]], [[Hatred]], [[Mind trick/Legends|Illusion]], [[Telepathy/Legends|Telepathy]], and the [[Force storm (weather)|summoning]] of storms, although when a familiar was used in such a manner, the [[Force energy|energy]] required to sustain the Force conduit sometimes could consume the creature, resulting in its [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Gamer 5" />

==History==
The Sith pioneered the creation of Sith familiars at some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history<ref name="Gamer 5" /> but were not the only culture to utilize familiars. The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] possessed [[Familiar (Nightsister)/Legends|familiars]] of their own, though they were different in nature to those of the Sith.<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

==Sith familiars in the galaxy==
Sith familiars saw usage amongst the Sith, although their creation was not widespread, and the propagation of familiars remained one of the lesser-known applications of Sith alchemy. Many Sith were dissuaded from deploying familiars by the expense and time required when creating them, although some [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] did consider the benefits of possessing the creatures to be worth the effort.<ref name="Gamer 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sith familiars were created by [[Michael Mikaelian]] and first mentioned in ''[[The Sith Compendium]]'', an article in the [[2001]] magazine [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]] that provided [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] statistics for various Sith-related weapons, vehicles, and creatures.<ref name="Gamer 5" />
